definition.exactness: all subset sums Phi(S)=sum_{i in S} a_i are distinct for |S|<=d
definition.signed_relation_equivalence: no nonzero epsilon in {-1,0,1}^V with n_plus<=d, n_minus<=d, and sum_i epsilon_i a_i=0

oracle_scope.nonprime_prime_powers: out of scope until a finite-field implementation exists

boundaries.q2: equivalent to no nonempty GF(2) dependency among <=2d columns
boundaries.q_gt_2: arbitrary-coefficient small-column independence is sufficient but not generally equivalent
boundaries.sidon_bh: definition map required before equivalence claims
boundaries.locality: write/change locality; not LCC/LDC query locality
boundaries.nested: pure nestedness tax deprioritized; nested+update-locality retained
boundaries.computation: deferred until independent cost model is frozen
